title: Rewind to the borrow phase
statement: Let $x$ be a binary input, let $p$ be any input-head position, let $u$ be a binary word, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j \le |u|$. Starting with the countdown machine in its startup state, with work tape containing $u$, work-head position $j-1$, input-head position $p$, and empty output, after exactly $j+1$ steps it is in the borrow phase with work-head position $0$, tape still containing $u$, input-head position still $p$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: Input-head position $p$ among the valid positions for $x$
replaced: For every input position, every counter word $u$ and every $j \le |u|$: from the startup-rewind configuration with work head at cell $j-1$, exactly $j+1$ steps of the countdown emitter reach the borrow state at cell zero with counter $u$ and empty output.
